items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Month grid on the WAI-ARIA date grid pattern with no dependencies (Date + Intl): always 7 x 6 cells of the compact control step, dim outside days, single and range selection with hover preview, min/max and disabled days, multiple months, keyboard navigation, renderDay slot, 오늘 footer and a pointer month fade.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. No dependencies: Date + Intl only, following the WAI-ARIA date grid pattern. Locale defaults to ko-KR; week start comes from Intl.Locale weekInfo (Monday fallback), override with weekStartsOn. Set lang on the wrapper for CJK leading. mode="range" selects start then end (a click before the start swaps them). Keys: arrows day/week, PageUp/PageDown month, Shift+PageUp/PageDown year, Home/End week start/end, Enter/Space select; disabled days are skipped. Use minDate, maxDate, isDateDisabled, numberOfMonths and renderDay (slot for event dots). The month slides with yorha motion tokens (reduced = opacity-only fade, off = instant) and the selected day wipes in dark. v3 BREAKING: the day is now a `button[data-slot=calendar-day]` inside the gridcell `td` (aria-selected, aria-current, data-in-range, data-preview moved to the td; data-date, data-selected, data-range-start/end, data-today, tabindex, aria-disabled stay on the button); the root is bordered (bordered={false} inside a popup) and exactly 7C+16 wide (C = --yorha-control-sm); the header holds the title left and prev/next together on the right (both in the last month's header); the title is no longer uppercase; day buttons are named with the full date (`14, 2026년 11월 14일 토요일, 오늘`); the glyph and in-month wrapper `calendar-month-body` is now `calendar-months`; selected is ink (was control). New props: showOutsideDays, fixedWeeks (6 rows always), showToday, bordered, labels.today, labels.pendingRange; CalendarDayState.preview. Migrate selectors from `td[data-date]` to `button[data-date]` and read selection from `button.closest('td')`.
